# SpeedyIndex MCP

> Unofficial Bun/TypeScript stdio MCP server. Seven implemented tools: get_balance, list_tasks, get_task_status, get_task_report, guarded create_indexing_task, create_index_check, and create_backlink_check. Index-check and backlink-check reservations require operator-selected profiles and are not provider fees. Writes default off; pure previews require no key/state, and submissions need explicit private policy and existing V1 or V2 state. Five tools and one-shot retry automation remain roadmap work. No npm release is published.

Backlink checks preserve 1 to 50 safe target strings (up to 8,192 UTF-8 bytes each), including case, order and duplicates. Submit needs enabled configuration, explicit backlink permission and a complete private three-unit profile. The local token floor is 2 per donor; other fees and target-count effects are unknown. All three create tools share donor-wide V1/V2 holds and caps. See README for policy validity, exact-body identity and restart/replay limits.
